Ukrainian soldiers have become the first in the world to evacuate a wounded fighter from the front line using an aerial drone. This was reported by the 92nd Assault Brigade. They deployed a heavy hexacopter manufactured by Ukraine's Gurzuf Defence. The operation was successful. h
